name: D1Bound5.finitePDividedMatrix_det
original_signature:
(a b s c : R) :
    (finitePDividedMatrix a b s c).det =
      -78750*a*b*s*(a-b)^5*(a-s)*(b-s)*finitePDetFactor a b s c

name: D1Bound5.finitePMatrix_det
original_signature:
(a b s c : R) :
    (finitePMatrix a b s c).det =
      -78750*a^2*b^2*s^2*(a-b)^5*(a-s)*(b-s)*finitePDetFactor a b s c

name: D1Bound5.finiteP_factor_identity
original_signature:
{R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b s : R) :
    (a-b)^2 = 4*finitePLeadingFactor a b s-(6*s+a+b)*finitePLinearFactor a b s

name: D1Bound5.map_finitePLeadingFactor
original_signature:
{R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a b s : R) :
    f (finitePLeadingFactor a b s) = finitePLeadingFactor (f a) (f b) (f s)

name: D1Bound5.map_finitePDividedMatrix
original_signature:
{R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a b s c : R) (i j : Fin 4) :
    f (finitePDividedMatrix a b s c i j) =
      finitePDividedMatrix (f a) (f b) (f s) (f c) i j
explicit_arguments: f a b s c i j
